tool: VCFcache, branch feature/fused-routing at c878d86c3, engines legacy and fused

result.legacy_span_dependence: flat 19.6-21.3 s from 1 to 22 contigs: a full-cache pass, unrestricted
result.region_restriction_win: 2x at 2-4 contigs (10.2 s vs 19.5 s legacy)
result.panel_split: legacy 27.0 s total = 23.7 s VCFcache + 3.3 s VEP (3 misses of 203)
result.wes_split: legacy 156.3 s total = 27.0 s VCFcache + 129.3 s VEP (1,339 misses of 75,135)

note: Answers where the campaign's panel loss (0.41-0.46x) comes from: it is a full-cache pass, not annotator start-up and not per-variant work. Region-restricted routing already exists in the fused route stage and is worth 2x at 2-4 contigs, but a single-contig regression (5.7x worse than legacy) and worker imbalance at 22 contigs (per-worker route 9.9/21.3/32.6/45.6 s) make fused's fixed term worse than legacy's at the spans real assays have. Fused must not be promoted to default on this evidence. See ANALYSIS.md for caveats, including that the 98.2-98.5% hit rates here are 1000 Genomes against a gnomAD cache and are NOT cohort coverage results.
